description:
Register a callback subscription on an organization

Registers an organization callback subscription. Pass the callback URL and events to deliver. Builder encrypts signed results when the organization enables result encryption.

body.description: Body for `POST /orgs/{orgId}/callback-subscriptions`. The owning organization comes from the path; bearer-authenticated and gated on org membership. Delivery is scoped to the org and encrypted to its credential when set. Send `callbackUrl` for a webhook, or `deliveryMode: "pull"` for a subscription you read.

oneOf.description: A subscription that Builder POSTs each delivery to.

callbackUrl.description: Callback URL or template. Supported placeholders are `{{sessionId}}` and top-level scalar context keys.

items.description:
Canonical Builder lifecycle event. Names use lower snake case; metadata uses camel case. Provider events include providerId, resolvedVersion, and ordinal. Request events also include requestId. New values are additive, so clients must tolerate unknown response values. For field requirements and funnel semantics, see docs/verification-analytics-events.md. The `ai_*` events belong to AI sessions and have phase `search`. The AI agent reports them through the Portal. Their `eventData` is `{ source: "ai-agent", aiSdkSessionId, field?, found?, missing? }`. `field`, `found`, and `missing` hold data point names, never values. `ai_search_started` means the agent began looking for the data points. `ai_field_found` means it found one, and `field` names it. `ai_search_completed` means it found every required one. `ai_search_failed` means it didn't, and `missing` names what it lacked.
Six more `ai_*` events cover the email fallback. `ai_website_failed` is only for Builder: it records that the website attempt failed, with `{ source: "builder", aiSdkSessionId, status, reasonCode }`. The Portal reports the others with `{ source: "ai-agent", aiSdkSessionId }` plus the fields noted here. `ai_email_connected` means the user connected an email account. `ai_email_selected` means the user picked an email to check, and can repeat. `ai_email_searched` means the user searched their mailbox, adds `query` (masked by the Portal, at most 200 characters), `resultCount` (a whole number, 0 or more), and `suggested` (true when the query is the unchanged prefilled suggestion), and can repeat. `ai_email_rejected` means the check rejected an email, adds `reasonCode`, and can repeat. `ai_email_verified` means the agent verified an email, and adds `found` and `missing`.

oneOf.description: A subscription whose deliveries wait for you to read them. It has no URL. An org has at most one.

callbackUrl.description: Not allowed. A pull subscription has no URL.

events.description: Events to keep. Defaults to every event.
